summary: H13 is rejected and cannot be a Golden reference. Its forest refinement produces conspicuous diamond, lozenge, cookie-like, and grid-aligned canopy repetition instead of fine irregular connected material. It also fails three of four unchanged B1 palette conditions and the 25% macrocell-coverage gate (0.802083 < 0.85). Two Vision immediate failures are present, and the score is 62/100, below the required 94.
required_changes: Remove every closed diamond, lozenge, cookie-like, and lattice-aligned canopy unit; rebuild forest from branching connected masses, broken edges, natural gaps, stipple, and short varied strokes.
Restore RGB intersection to at least 0.72, HSV intersection to at least 0.62, and Bhattacharyya similarity to at least 0.9 without changing canonical geometry.
Restore 25% macrocell contrast coverage to at least 0.85 without reintroducing a repeated stamp or grid cadence.
